label: Periodic floor and car stock
info: Standalone five-minute stock updates. See periodic-stock.README.md.

name: floor: prepare stock update
floor: query production from opening balance
floor: calculate and upsert each shift
floor: verify save and release lock
func: const s=msg.stock;const r=msg.payload;if(r?.acknowledged!==true&&r?.result?.ok!==1&&r?.ok!==1)throw Error('Stock bulk write was not acknowledged.');if(flow.get(s.key)?.id===s.id)flow.set(s.key,null);return {payload:{saved:true,kind:s.kind,documents:msg.stockDocuments.length,shiftIds:msg.stockDocuments.map(d=>d._id)}};
